design.target_shell: 1 <= D_KL(Q||P) <= 1.1 for Gaussian Q=N(mu,r), mu>=0; mu<0 follows by global sign symmetry

exact_simulator.snml_regret_increment: d_n=(n+1)/2 log n - n/2 log(n-1) - 1/2 log(2e) + log Gamma((n-1)/2)-log Gamma(n/2); r_b(N)=sum_{n=b+1}^N d_n
exact_simulator.joint_event: both adjacent candidates fail their own weighted threshold on the same generated path
exact_simulator.atomic_generation: for offset x in 0..16 generate independent Gaussian sufficient statistics for U=P^16, A=P^(T-16), gap P^x, gap Q^(16-x), and three Q^16 blocks; aggregate sums and within-SSE exactly for early/late candidates

stage1.selection: fixed before simulation: I in {1.00,1.01,...,1.10}; 101 equally spaced t values; at each I, log variance interpolates from the exact-level lower to upper variance root
stage1.rng: numpy PCG64; per-offset seed 246810+x; common random numbers reused across fixed stage1 anchors

stage2.selection: after stage1 coverage only, choose one shell point from each uncovered potential rectangle then deduplicate to 1073 anchors; evaluate these selected locations using independent stage2 Monte Carlo randomness
stage2.rng: numpy PCG64; per-offset seed 864209+x; independent of stage1 selection/evaluation randomness

monte_carlo.adaptivity_note: stage2 locations are data-dependent on stage1, so stage2 CP evaluation deliberately uses independent randomness; conditional on stage1 selection the stage2 exact-binomial bounds remain valid, and the two stage error budgets are union-bounded

transport_and_continuum_cover.gaussian_path_KL: for target Q and anchor Qa at offset x, D(path_Q||path_Qa)=(64-x) D_KL(Q||Qa)
transport_and_continuum_cover.binary_data_processing: if anchor CP gives p_a<=u<0.09, any target satisfying (64-x)D_KL(Q||Qa)<=kl(0.09||u) has target joint-pair failure <=0.09 at that offset
transport_and_continuum_cover.cell_intersection_test: D_P(mu,r)=0.5[mu^2+r-1-log r]. Its exact rectangle minimum uses mu_low and r clipped to 1; its maximum uses mu_high and the variance endpoint with larger r-1-log r. A rectangle is conservatively retained whenever min<=1.1 and max>=1.
transport_and_continuum_cover.cell_cover_test: For fixed anchor Qa, D_KL(Q||Qa) is jointly convex in (mu,r), with diagonal Hessian entries 1/ra and 1/(2r^2). Hence its maximum on each retained rectangle is attained at a corner. A cell is certified when one anchor has all four corner divergences <=rho_a.
transport_and_continuum_cover.result: Conditional on the simultaneous CP event and the stated float64 geometry, every Gaussian Q in the full shell 1<=D_KL(Q||P)<=1.1, both mean signs by symmetry, has neighboring-pair threshold-failure probability <=0.09 for every discrete offset x=0..16 under the H=48/T0=700 scale.

independent_engineering_stress.status: not part of the randomized certificate
independent_engineering_stress.grid: 21 information levels from 1 to 1.1 times 61 normalized log-variance directions times all 17 offsets
independent_engineering_stress.paired_radial_check: Across 31 normalized directions, all 17 offsets and 5000 common-random paths each, there were 0 cases out of 2,635,000 where the joint-failure event occurred at I=1.1 but not at I=1.0. This is engineering evidence only, not a monotonicity theorem.

scope_and_limitations: This closes only the first finite shell 1<=KL<=1.1 for Gaussian step changes, not all KL>=1.
The statistical Monte Carlo uncertainty is explicitly union-bounded, including the adaptive stage through independent stage2 evaluation.
The geometric cell/root arithmetic is ordinary float64 and has not yet been replaced by directed-rounding or interval arithmetic; therefore this is not machine-verified adoption-grade evidence.
No claim is made for heavy tails, non-Gaussian alternatives, within-sample changepoint mixtures, or other detector classes.
exact_next_action: Extend the direct-joint shell cover outward from 1.1 using the same two-stage independent-Monte-Carlo construction, preferably in progressively wider KL shells until an analytic high-information tail bound can take over. In parallel replace float64 shell-intersection and corner-cover comparisons with directed-rounding/interval arithmetic. Only after full KL>=1 coverage is closed should the 9-state {3,3,3} bank be treated as a full-floor candidate; then repeat the radial construction for I_floor=0.5/H=96 and I_floor=0.25/H=192.
